description: BestSource - FFmpeg-based audio/video source filter for VapourSynth with exact frame-accurate seeking
notes: The DLL stays in the package directory - link it into your VapourSynth plugin path yourself.

Upstream names the file after the release (BestSource-R20-win64-clang-vs-only.dll); it is renamed to BestSource.dll so a link to ...\apps\vp-bestsource\current\BestSource.dll keeps working across updates.
This packages the clang 'vs-only' build. If you also need AviSynth+, switch the url to BestSource-$version-win64-msvc.zip.
R20 needs VapourSynth R78 or newer (it uses the new turn functions for rotation).
